name: ceo-inbox-draft-edit
description: Update an existing draft email in the principal's personal inbox — change its recipients, subject, or body. Use to fix a draft that was already created (e.g. wrong recipient or outdated body) without recreating it. Requires the draft_id from ceo-inbox-list {folder: 'DRAFTS'} or ceo-inbox-search {folder: 'DRAFTS'}. Recipients change one at a time: remove takes people off, add_to/add_cc (contact IDs) or add_to_addresses/add_cc_addresses (addresses of non-contacts, copied exactly from the principal's mail) put people on, and everyone else stays as they are. Adding someone already on the other line moves them. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's personal email via dedicated secrets, do not call from other agents.

inputs.draft_id: string (Nylas draft ID to update — obtain from ceo-inbox-list or ceo-inbox-search scoped to DRAFTS)
inputs.add_to: string[]? (contact IDs, or "principal", to add to the To line; optional #label hint such as <contact-id>#work)
inputs.add_cc: string[]? (contact IDs to add to the CC line, same form as add_to)
inputs.add_to_addresses: string[]? (addresses of people who are not contacts to add to the To line, copied exactly from the principal's mail or the principal's message, or already on this draft)
inputs.add_cc_addresses: string[]? (addresses to add to the CC line, same rule as add_to_addresses)
inputs.remove: string[]? (recipients to take off the To and CC lines: a contact ID, or an address exactly as it appears on the draft)
inputs.subject: string? (new subject line)
inputs.body: string? (new email body; markdown supported, converted to HTML automatically)
